stations.title: Odile
stations.say: Which cafes are in Port Ellery?

stations.title: Bakehouse database
stations.text: Every cafe and order, in SQLite.
stations.note: Only its builder ever queried it.

captions: At Brindle Bakehouse, Odile needs every cafe in Port Ellery for her delivery round.
The answer is in the database, but nobody here knows how to ask it.
You write the queries that pick rows and columns, in three tasks.
Now your query lists the Port Ellery cafes with their emails.
Same database, a real answer. You ask the questions now.
